query.description: Free-text search query against Europe PMC. Combine keywords, protein names, function descriptions; field-qualified Europe PMC syntax (e.g. `TITLE:'...'`) is also accepted.

functional_description.description: Additional natural-language context describing what the user is trying to design. Used to refine query expansion and constraint extraction; not sent verbatim to Europe PMC.
examples: binder to checkpoint receptor on T cells

must_include.description: Terms that MUST appear in matching records (post-filter). Useful when the base `query` is broad and you want to require specific keywords.

organism.description: Species filter (free text matched against organism mentions). Null disables organism filtering.

max_results.description: Cap on the number of records returned after filtering. Larger values incur more API calls.

published_before.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD); only records published on/before this date are returned.

published_after.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD); only records published on/after this date are returned.

temporal_cutoff.description: Deprecated alias for `published_before`. Supplying both with different values is rejected; prefer `published_before` for new code.

result_type.description: `core` (default) returns full records including abstracts; `lite` is metadata-only. Setting `include_abstracts=true` automatically coerces `lite` up to `core`.

open_access_only.description: When true, restrict to open-access articles (Europe PMC `OPEN_ACCESS:Y`).

include_abstracts.description: When true, abstract snippets are populated on top_records (requires `result_type=core`; coerced automatically when needed).

page_size.description: Records per Europe PMC API page request.

max_query_terms.description: Upper bound on tokens after query normalization. LLM-authored multi-concept queries are truncated to this many terms to keep the Europe PMC query within sane length.

fetch_text_mined_terms.description: When true, calls Europe PMC's annotations API for records flagged `hasTextMinedTerms=Y` and populates `constraint_evidence` + `text_mined_annotations` in the output. Slower but vastly richer per-record metadata.
